id: \bCongratulations on winning the Manalo Conference and becoming the Alolan Champion.
en: \bCongratulations on winning the Manalo Conference and becoming the Alolan Champion.
it: \bCongratulazioni per aver vinto la Conferenza di Manalo e per essere diventato Campione di Alola.

id: \bSpeak to Professor Kukui whenever you're ready to start the ceremony.
en: \bSpeak to Professor Kukui whenever you're ready to start the ceremony.
it: \bParla con il Professor Kukui quando sei pronto per iniziare la cerimonia.

id: \bGladion: So, it's just you and me, \PN. Let's not wait any longer.
en: \bGladion: So, it's just you and me, \PN. Let's not wait any longer.
it: \bIridio: Allora siamo rimasti solo io e te, \PN. Non aspettiamo oltre.

id: \bKukui: Are you pumped, cousin? This match may just be for fun but I'm going to give it everything I have.
en: \bKukui: Are you pumped, cousin? This match may just be for fun but I'm going to give it everything I have.
it: \bKukui: Sei carico, cugino? Questo incontro sarà anche solo per divertimento, ma io darò tutto quello che ho.

id: \bKukui: Wonderful fight. Perhaps we can do it again someday.
en: \bKukui: Wonderful fight. Perhaps we can do it again someday.
it: \bKukui: Lotta splendida. Magari un giorno potremo rifarla.

id: \bThis wasn't for any reward, but you deserve this.
en: \bThis wasn't for any reward, but you deserve this.
it: \bNon era per nessuna ricompensa, ma questo te lo meriti.

id: \bGladion: It's you and me again, \PN, even if it isn't the finals this time. Let's not wait any longer.
en: \bGladion: It's you and me again, \PN, even if it isn't the finals this time. Let's not wait any longer.
it: \bIridio: Di nuovo io e te, \PN, anche se stavolta non è la finale. Non aspettiamo oltre.

id: \bGladion: Excellent. If I had to lose to anyone it should be you.
en: \bGladion: Excellent. If I had to lose to anyone it should be you.
it: \bIridio: Eccellente. Se dovevo perdere contro qualcuno, era giusto che fossi tu.

id: \bCongratulations on winning your fourth match. \nYour next battle will be here again.
en: \bCongratulations on winning your fourth match. \nYour next battle will be here again.
it: \bCongratulazioni per aver vinto il tuo quarto incontro. \nIl tuo prossimo incontro si terrà di nuovo qui.

id: \bGladion: Yes! I know you'll get even stronger though, so I'll be on my guard.
en: \bGladion: Yes! I know you'll get even stronger though, so I'll be on my guard.
it: \bIridio: Sì! Ma so che diventerai ancora più forte, quindi starò in guardia.

id: \bKukui: Are you pumped, cousin? Even if this match is for the Champion title, let's have fun while giving it everything we've got!
en: \bKukui: Are you pumped, cousin? Even if this match is for the Champion title, let's have fun while giving it everything we've got!
it: \bKukui: Sei carico, cugino? Anche se in palio c'è il titolo di Campione, divertiamoci dando il massimo!

id: \bKukui: Woo! I couldn't have such a satisfying victory against anyone else!
en: \bKukui: Woo! I couldn't have such a satisfying victory against anyone else!
it: \bKukui: Woo! Una vittoria così soddisfacente non avrei potuto ottenerla contro nessun altro!

id: \bKukui: Wonderful fight. Let's do it again someday when we've got time.
en: \bKukui: Wonderful fight. Let's do it again someday when we've got time.
it: \bKukui: Splendido incontro. Rifacciamolo un giorno, quando avremo tempo.

id: Congratulations on successfully defending your title of Alola's Champion!
en: Congratulations on successfully defending your title of Alola's Champion!
it: Congratulazioni per aver difeso con successo il titolo di Campione di Alola!
